meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成 GitHub PR 的代码讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要向同事或客户解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes to non-technical stakeholders

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把 GitHub 的一个 Pull Request(提供链接、owner/repo#N 或已检出仓库里说“this PR”)做成代码变更解说视频。它会读取该 PR 的 diff、提交与文件,规划故事板和脚本,生成旁白,最终渲染成 mp4 成片。风格固定为 code-editorial。
howto.when: 当用户提供 GitHub PR(链接、owner/repo#N 或已检出仓库里的“this PR”),并要求把它做成代码变更解说视频时触发,涵盖 changelog、功能展示、修复或重构。非 PR 的视频请求不会触发,由 /hyperframes 分流。

say.text: 给 owner/repo#123 做一个修复说明视频。
say.note: 会先确认 PR 引用,再规划故事板。

say.text: 在当前仓库里,把这个 PR 变成 changelog 视频。
say.note: 需要先检出仓库,并说“this PR”。

howto.what_en: Claude turns a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or “this PR”) into a code-change explainer video: it fetches the diff/commits/files, plans storyboard and script, generates narration, and renders an mp4 with the fixed code-editorial style.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user gives a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or “this PR”) and asks for a code-change explainer video (changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor). Non-PR video requests go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/1842 into an explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the PR and starts production.

say_en.text: Make a fix explainer for owner/repo#123.
say_en.note: Confirms the PR ref, then plans the storyboard.

say_en.text: Turn this PR in the current repo into a changelog video.
say_en.note: Works when you say “this PR” in a checked-out repo.
